leads.title: Bahrain says an Iranian strike set a site on fire
leads.body: No one hurt, Bahrain says; Iran claims it hit 2 US radars. Separately, UKMTO says 2 tankers were hit off Oman.

leads.title: EU and Indonesia sign trade pact after a decade of talks
leads.body: Signed in Brussels with investment pact; duties go on 98.5% of EU tariff lines and 90.4% of Indonesia's.

leads.title: Mexico captures 'El Chapo Isidro'; 11 die in clashes
leads.body: FBI top-10 fugitive Fausto Isidro Meza Flores held in Guasave; officials say 4 soldiers and 7 gunmen died.
